name: cohort
description: Shared AI memory for teams: a git vault of markdown, human-approved, injection-safe, local-only.

vault_dir.title: Vault folder
vault_dir.description: The git folder that holds your team's Cohort memory (facts, decisions, threads).

tools.name: cohort_load
tools.description: Return bounded, verified-first team context, fenced as data.

tools.name: cohort_propose
tools.description: Run proposed records through the server-enforced write gate.

tools.name: cohort_status
tools.description: Report policy, record counts, the quarantine queue, and stale records.

tools.name: cohort_policy_get
tools.description: Return the caller's effective, read-only policy limits.

tools.name: cohort_search
tools.description: Search the vault, verified-only by default.

tools.name: cohort_why
tools.description: Return a record's provenance, read from git history.
